title: Runtime Radar — Friday sync agenda (prep)
content:
Purpose: quick weekly sync to surface regressions, unblock cross-team ops, and confirm rollouts. Keep to 30–35 min. This is my prep scratchpad — informal, includes questions I want to ask, and a short action tracker for after the meeting.

Time / cadence: Fridays 10:00–10:35 PT (proposed) — reduce to 30m if no blockers. Alternate every other week to deep-dive on rollout telemetry.

Attendees (ask to RSVP): eng-serving-runtime leads, infra-oncall, console-sowner, release-eng rep, SRE liaison.

Pre-read / signals I want up front (send 1h before):
- p50/p95 token-latency (hosted + dedicated) last 48h (console route breakdown)
- queue depth and preemption events in last 24h
- tail-kb distribution for recent large prompts (>4k tokens)
- GPU util & memory fragmentation trend for dedicated pools
- any failed canaries in the last 24h
(Links: will paste console dashboard and small screenshots into Slack)

Agenda (30–35m):
1) Quick run of top 3 signals (5m) — owner: Emilia
   - Hit metrics above and call out anything >15% change week-over-week.
2) Current rollouts and confidence (8m) — owner: Kai
   - Canary status for optimized kernel set (PR #412). If failure rate >0.5% fallback plan?
   - Note: set threshold for auto-fallback to 1% until next hotfix.
3) Blocking incidents / customer-impact items (6m) — owner: Samir
   - Any active tickets (e.g., RINF-2291) that need cross-team pairing?
4) Console UX brief: where ops were confused this week (4m) — owner: Rosa
   - Quick wins to surface: clearer error codes for cache misses, explicit batch size display.
5) Action item sync and owners (6m) — owner: Emilia
   - Confirm deadlines and pairing.
6) Parking lot + quick ask time (2m)

Follow-ups from last sync (quick status summary):
- GH PR 398: kernel selection metrics added — deployed to canary (status: partial rollout, 30% traffic). TODO: collect 48h of telemetry before expanding. (owner: Kai)
- Oncall runbook add: preemptive GPU restart checklist — merged but needs one SRE review. (owner: Samir)
- Internal doc: 'prompt-size budget guidance' — draft posted to Confluence, awaiting product feedback. (owner: Emilia)

Action items (tracking table, informal):
- Action 1: Expand canary for kernel-selection PR #412 to 60% if error rate <0.4% in next 48h. Owner: Kai. Due: 2026-03-15.
- Action 2: Create short playbook for 'large prompt OOM' (includes mitigation steps: smaller batch, partial KV cache eviction, fallback model). Owner: Samir + SRE. Due: 2026-03-18.
- Action 3: Add batch-size and estimated token-cost columns to Console route view. Owner: Rosa. Due: 2026-03-20.
- Action 4: Run a 2-hour soak on dedicated pool with mixed-sequence workload and capture p99 token latency. Owner: Emilia (coordinate infra). Due: 2026-03-17.
- Action 5: Postmortem outline for RINF-2291 and share to #runtime-ops. Owner: Kai. Due: 2026-03-16.

Personal notes to self (things to ask in the sync):
- Ask infra if there's recurring fragmentation on GPU nodes (same UUIDs?). If yes, propose weekly compacting job.
- Clarify whether reserved capacity autoscaler is logging decisions we can show in console.
- Confirm fallback model variants list and size/quantization so product knows latency tradeoffs.

Open questions (bring to meeting if time):
- Is the 1% auto-fallback threshold acceptable for prod? Proposal: 1% error triggers fallback; 0.5% for canary.
- Can we add an 'ops-mode' toggle for rollout (manual approval vs auto-scale) visible in Console?

Parking lot (non-urgent):
- Template for 'customer-facing incident note' for model regressions (to share with CS).
- Consider adding an internal 'noise filter' for alerts when small experiments spike latency for <10min.

Quick link dump I'll paste in Slack pre-meeting:
- Canary dashboard (console): https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/canary-kernel-412
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/412
- Jira: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RINF-2291
- Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=98765

Post-meeting ritual (my checklist):
- Update action items in Jira cards + assign watchers.
- Post summary message in #runtime-ops with 1–2 bullets and link to notes.
- If any customer impact, ping CS lead and include proposed communication.

Tone / format note: keep this as a loose scratchpad. Convert to a cleaned agenda doc only if any external stakeholders will be invited.

Last quick diary: felt runway was tight this week; prioritize the canary telemetry and GPU fragmentation check. Remind myself to follow up 1:1 with Kai on rollout params (10m).
